name: lisachenko/native-php-matrix
description: PHP extension that provides Matrix class powered with overloaded operators

suggest.lib-openblas: Install the OpenBLAS shared library (Debian/Ubuntu: libopenblas0, Homebrew: openblas) to enable the CPU-accelerated "blas" backend
suggest.lib-clblast: Install CLBlast and an OpenCL runtime (Debian/Ubuntu: libclblast1, ocl-icd-libopencl1 plus a vendor ICD or pocl-opencl-icd) to enable the GPU-accelerated "clblast" backend

scripts-descriptions.bench: Compare the matrix backends on the operations of a neural network layer
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Run static analysis at the maximum level
